title: Data-Efficient Off-Policy Policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning

content.abstract_summary: Presents MAGIC, a data-efficient and robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OPE) estimator that combines doubly robust estimators with model-based approaches, offering high-confidence safety guarantees when evaluating new decision policies from historical execution logs.
key_findings: Standard importance sampling suffers from excessive variance, while model-based estimators suffer from high bias under model misspecification
Doubly robust (DR) and weighted doubly robust (WDR) estimators achieve unbiasedness while drastically reducing variance
Derives concentration inequalities providing high-confidence lower bounds on policy performance, enabling rigorous safety gating
Critical methodological framework for proving an AI-derived dosing policy is safe before running prospective clinical trials
limitations: Requires accurate estimation of behavior policy probabilities (propensity scores)
High variance if target policy takes actions that had near-zero probability in historical data

extracted_claims.text: Off-policy policy evaluation allows practitioners to predict the performance of a proposed policy using historical data generated by a different policy without requiring hazardous online experimentation.

gaps_addressed: Provides mathematical statistical methods for evaluating precision dosing policies prior to clinical deployment in Pillar 3 (M3.6)

provenance.notes: Added 2026-08-29 by Antigravity review. Core reference for off-policy evaluation and safety verification in precision dosing.
